content:
We have three templates returned. Need to apply the appropriate one to our target molecule. The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The template result from template_search-2 is the one we just retrieved? The search returned multiple templates; we need the one that matches the description (HWE). Likely the first template (reaction_id 1914389) is the HWE with phosphonate. Let's use its retro_smarts_template. We need to apply it to the target molecule. The target molecule is the same as earlier: there were three SMILES from apply_template-1 answer. Those are three possible protected forms? Actually those are product molecules? The earlier answer gave list of lists each containing a single SMILES (the product). So we need to apply the template to each of those three SMILES to get precursors.

We have template ID? We have template_hash but need template_id to apply. The tool get_template can retrieve by ID, but we have no ID. Maybe we can use apply_template with template_id as the hash? Usually template_id is something like the hash. Let's try apply_template with template_id = the hash of first template. Use apply_template.

We'll pick first template hash: '08ee5634068b7d2252386ed345c976109c0ade74ddd41327125f608792ea18dd'.

We'll apply to each of the three SMILES.

First SMILES list from earlier: 
1) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO'
2) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C'
3) 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO'

We apply template to each.
